The supervisor, Dimple, was very courteous and assisted us in navigating through the activities. The play zone offers multiple activities, including toy cars, see-saws, slides, rock climbing, hurdle walks, trampolines, a caterpillar play tunnel, and a fast car track. All equipment and toys were well maintained and appeared safe. Popular rhymes played softly in the background, creating a pleasant and soothing atmosphere.
Overall, I was very satisfied with the time we spent at this play zone. It offered a calm alternative to the larger, often chaotic and expensive play zones typically found in malls. In comparison, this one was quiet, well-organized, and efficiently managed.
